pr_body:
c2c: add acceptance test

This patch adds a lightweight acceptance test that calls the main c2c roachtest
driver. This will add a c2c roachtest to Essential CI, preventing future
patches from inadvertently breaking the C2C roachtest driver.

Fixes #99230

Release note: None
pr_comments: This change is [](https://reviewable.io/reviews/cockroachdb/cockroach/99468)
I've run it locally a bunch of times and it's been stable. It takes about a minute to run. I'll bump the current timeout from 5 to 10 mins to be extra cautious.

I started a 100-run of this test earlier today and haven't seen failures so far. Can we wait for this to finish before we merge? For comparison, when we recently merged a change that made `acceptance/version-upgrade` to flake very frequently in CI, it took 48 runs to reproduce it locally (in other words, CI has a special sauce that is difficult to replicate, so we should run it hundreds of times locally before we have any hopes of stability in CI).

It won't block the merge for too long (currently at 70 runs), I'll send an update when it finishes.

issue_context.title: c2c: write local c2c roachtest for CI
issue_context.body:
We often merge c2c features without double checking how it affects the c2c roachtest framework. To avoid this, let's write a local roachtest that runs through CI that exercises the c2c roachtest framework. 


Jira issue: CRDB-25775

review_comments: Do we need 3 nodes? Can we run the workload on the src node? I suppose since this is "local" it doesn't really matter?
To exercise the c2c roachtest driver, we need 3 nodes: 1 for src, 1 for dst, 1 for workload.
